_comment: Anchor points in each sprite's own pixel coordinates (origin top-left). A snake's tail anchor is the tip of its tail and its head anchor is the centre of the head circle. For ladders, top_anchor is the centre of the top rung (in the top piece) and foot_anchor is the centre of the feet pad (in the bottom piece). body_width is the widest part of the snake body in pixels. If the art changes, update this file; tests check every anchor lies inside its image.
